title: Application and Petition of the Commonwealth Electric Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 14, for approval and authorization to issue and sell up to 500,000 shares of common capital stock, $25 par value at no less than par; to issue and sell, on a negotiated basis, additional long-term notes in the aggregate principal amount of up to $45,000,000; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. c. 164, § 15; and for such other action as may be deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with the foregoing.
